title: Elliptic Clausen Functions and Degenerations Circular, Elliptic, and Hyperbolic Parallelism
summary: We introduce a unified elliptic extension of CL-type Clausen functions based on logarithmic primitives of the Jacobi theta function. The resulting elliptic Clausen family satisfies the same integral recursion as the classical circular case, with all differences encoded in boundary constants determined by the underlying logarithmic kernel. This separation clarifies a strict parallelism between circular, elliptic, and hyperbolic regimes and makes their degeneration limits transparent.
